uncited: **Layer Preparation:** For each layer $i$, generate or retrieve the 2D image $I_i$ representing the cross-section of the 3D object at depth $z_i$.
**Perspective Projection:** Adjust the content of each layer $I_i$ based on the viewer's position $E$ to simulate a virtual image located at depth $z_i$.
**Reflection and Transmission:** The semi-reflective surface reflects a portion of the light ($R_i$) towards the viewer and transmits the remainder ($T_i$) to the next layer or background.
**Superposition:** The viewer perceives the superimposed images from all layers $i=1 \dots N$.
*   **Layer Thickness ($t_i$):** Evaluated alongside light reflection and transmission properties to optimize image quality.
